## Overview

Pravine Mani runs a one-person consultancy in Toronto, Canada. Four focus areas: AI workflows (Claude Code, MCP, agent systems), programmatic SEO + GEO (Schema.org, llms.txt, passage-level citability), marketing automation (lead pipelines, lifecycle email, CRM wiring), and Agentic OS (multi-agent orchestration, sub-agent design, concurrent-agent evals). McMaster Computer Engineering & Management graduate (2025). Background: 5G software engineering at Ericsson (Go, gRPC). Full-stack development at Imprimo (React Native, Postgres). Mobile development at Fixvi (React Native, push infra).

## Focus Areas

- [AI workflows](https://pravinemani.com/services/ai/): Custom workflows. MCP servers. Agent systems. Prompt + eval suites. Code-first on Claude Code + Vercel.
- [SEO + GEO](https://pravinemani.com/services/seo/): Programmatic SEO at scale. Schema.org structured data. AI-search visibility (llms.txt + passage citability). Local SEO.
- [Marketing automation](https://pravinemani.com/services/marketing-automation/): Lead pipelines. Lifecycle email. CRM + webhook wiring. Stripe subscriptions. Vercel + Resend + Supabase.
- [Agentic OS](https://pravinemani.com/services/agentic-os/): Multi-agent orchestration. Sub-agent design. Concurrent-agent evals. R&D stage. Open for first-mover engagements.

## Engagement Shapes

- [Scoping Call](https://pravinemani.com/services/#scoping-call): 30-minute scoping call. Free. By appointment. The starting point for every engagement. Walk through one workflow. Decide whether Audit, Sprint, or Custom fits.
- [System Audit](https://pravinemani.com/services/#audit): Fixed-scope week. Maps the business. Identifies high-impact opportunities across any focus area. From $4,500.
- [Build Sprint](https://pravinemani.com/services/#sprint): Productized fixed-scope build of a single workflow. From $4,500.
- [Custom Build](https://pravinemani.com/services/#custom): Multi-workflow builds. Content engines, MCP servers, full marketing sites with SEO + admin portals. From $12K. Milestone-paid.

## Case Studies

- [CISNET: Marketing site + SEO + admin portal rebuild](https://pravinemani.com/work/case-studies/cisnet/): Migrated a Toronto IT certification training company off legacy PHP onto Next.js 16. Delivered 200+ programmatic SEO pages. 70+ individually-mapped redirects. 7 Schema.org JSON-LD types. Full lead pipeline (Facebook Lead Ads → HMAC webhook → Supabase → admin portal → Resend). Stripe Checkout. Custom admin portal for leads, enrollments, content, payments. Three months. Solo. Zero scope creep.
